# Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Community

> Build with Copilot, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform. Explore community samples, guidance, SDKs, tools, videos, community calls, and ways to contribute.

This portal connects the Microsoft 365 and Power Platform community with guidance, sample galleries, SDKs, tools, videos, and community calls. Linked projects and publications are maintained at their respective destinations.

## Start here

- [Community portal](https://pnp.github.io/)
- [Community blog](https://pnp.github.io/blog/): Read contributions from community members.
- [Publish a community blog post](https://github.com/pnp/blog/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Volunteer for a community-call demo](https://aka.ms/community/request/demo)
- [Sharing is Caring](https://aka.ms/sharing-is-caring): Get help starting your community contributions.
- [Community recognition](https://aka.ms/community/recognition): Explore contributor recognition, criteria, and registration details.
- [Microsoft Community Learning on YouTube](https://aka.ms/community/youtube)
- [CommunityDays](https://communitydays.org): Our partner for discovering in-person community events.
- [Community calls calendar](https://pnp.github.io/calendar.ics): Subscribe to the published calendar.
- [Community calls JSON](https://pnp.github.io/ical/calendar.json): Read current occurrences and statuses from the published feed rather than inferring upcoming dates from recurring-call descriptions.

## Community calls


- [Copilot, Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Call](https://aka.ms/community/ms-speakers-call-join): Presented by Microsoft. Weekly on Tuesdays. 8:00 AM PT / 3:00 PM GMT


- [Copilot, Microsoft 365 & Power Platform](https://aka.ms/community/m365-powerplat-call-join): Presented by the Community. Weekly on Thursdays. 7:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM GMT


- [Power Platform & Copilot Studio Monthly Call](https://aka.ms/PowerPlatformMonthlyCall): Presented by the Community. Third Wednesday of every month. 8:00 AM PT / 4:00 PM GMT


- [Copilot Extensibility Monthly Call](https://aka.ms/community/CopilotExtensibility-call-join): Presented by Microsoft. Second Wednesday of every month. 8:00 AM PT / 3:00 PM GMT


- [Maturity Model for Microsoft 365](https://aka.ms/mm4m365/join-call): Presented by the Community. Third Tuesday of every month. 7:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM GMT


- [Dynamics 365 Community Call (CRM Edition)](https://aka.ms/D365CRMCommunityCall-Join): Presented by the Community & Microsoft. First Wednesday of every month. 7:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM GMT


- [Dynamics 365 Community Call (ERP Edition)](https://aka.ms/D365ERPCommunityCall-Join): Presented by the Community & Microsoft. Second Wednesday of every month. 7:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM GMT


- [Microsoft Global Community Initiative (MGCI)](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/category/microsoft-global-community-initiative): Presented by the Community & Microsoft. <no value>


- [Microsoft 365 Champion program](https://aka.ms/M365Champions): <no value>












## Guidance

Find documentation, learning resources, and best practices for Copilot, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and Power Platform.

- [Copilot Developer Camp](https://microsoft.github.io/copilot-camp/): Learn to extend Microsoft 365 Copilot through hands-on labs for declarative agents, custom engine agents, and connected experiences.

- [Copilot Extensibility](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-copilot/extensibility/overview): Explore supported ways to extend Microsoft 365 Copilot and build Copilot-powered apps and custom agents.

- [Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/): Learn how to build, publish, and manage agents and workflows with Microsoft Copilot Studio.

- [Copilot Studio Agent Academy](https://microsoft.github.io/agent-academy/): Build your Copilot Studio skills through free, open-source courses and hands-on labs, from your first agent to advanced integrations.

- [Maturity Model for Microsoft 365](https://pnp.github.io/maturity-model/): The Maturity Model for Microsoft 365 is a framework that helps organizations assess and improve their adoption and usage of Microsoft 365 services.

- [Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Community Blog](https://pnp.github.io/blog/): Learn from community articles, practical solutions, and shared experiences, or publish what you've learned.

- [Microsoft Agent Resources](https://microsoft.github.io/agent-resources/): Explore CAT-curated guidance for adopting, building, deploying, and managing agents across Microsoft Copilot and agent platforms.

- [Microsoft Community Learning on YouTube](https://aka.ms/community/youtube): Watch community demos, tutorials, and call recordings for Copilot, Microsoft 365 & Power Platform.

- [Microsoft Copilot Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/): Plan, deploy, secure, and manage Microsoft Copilot services, Copilot Chat, and agents across Microsoft 365.

- [Microsoft Graph](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/): Microsoft Graph is the gateway to data and intelligence in Microsoft 365.

- [Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/): Learn more to help you build custom Microsoft Teams apps.

- [Power Platform Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/): Find documentation, training, and guidance for Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Power BI, and Power Platform administration.

- [Power Platform Well-Architected](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/well-architected/): Design reliable, secure, performant Power Platform workloads using architecture principles, review checklists, and assessment tools.

- [SharePoint Framework (SPFx)](https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/dev/spfx/sharepoint-framework-overview): Extend and personalize Microsoft 365. Create responsive and engaging web parts, teams apps, adaptive card extensions and application extensions.

- [SharePoint Modernization](https://aka.ms/sharepoint/modernization): Transformation of "classic" SharePoint into "modern".

- [Sharing is Caring](https://aka.ms/sharing-is-caring): Start contributing to the community with these small group, hands-on webinars, conducted in a safe space.





## Samples & Solutions

Explore community sample galleries and solutions for Copilot, SharePoint, Power Platform, Teams, Office, and Microsoft 365.

- [Copilot Prompts](https://pnp.github.io/copilot-prompts/): Discover reusable prompts, agent instructions, and skills for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and GitHub Copilot.

- [SharePoint Skills Gallery](https://pnp.github.io/sharepoint-skills/): Find community-built skills for Microsoft 365 Copilot in SharePoint and turn shared knowledge into reusable experiences.

- [List Formatting](https://pnp.github.io/List-Formatting/): Explore community-built JSON column and view formats for SharePoint and Microsoft Lists, ready to copy and adapt.

- [SPFx](https://pnp.github.io/spfx/): Browse community-built SharePoint Framework samples for Copilot, SharePoint, Teams, Viva Connections, and Microsoft 365 experiences.

- [Copilot UX Components](https://pnp.github.io/spfx-copilot-components/): Build interactive experiences in the Microsoft Copilot canvas with community-built UX components.

- [Pro-code Copilot Agents](https://pnp.github.io/copilot-pro-dev-samples/): Explore community-built agents, plugins, and code-first extensibility patterns for Microsoft 365 Copilot.

- [Power Platform Samples](https://pnp.github.io/powerplatform-samples/): Discover community-built apps, automations, agents, and solutions for Microsoft Power Platform.

- [Power Platform Snippets](https://pnp.github.io/powerplatform-snippets): Explore reusable Power Platform snippets, UI patterns, Power Fx techniques, and agent topics.

- [Script Samples](https://pnp.github.io/script-samples/): Manage Microsoft 365 with community scripts and automation scenarios using PnP PowerShell, CLI for Microsoft 365, and other tools.

- [Learning Pathways](https://github.com/pnp/custom-learning-office-365): Help employees learn Microsoft 365 with a customizable, community-supported learning solution.

- [Office Add-in Samples](https://github.com/OfficeDev/Office-Add-in-samples): Learn how to extend Office with practical add-in code samples, APIs, and implementation patterns.

- [PnP Modern Search](https://microsoft-search.github.io/pnp-modern-search/): Create flexible, personalized search experiences for SharePoint and Microsoft 365 with community-maintained web parts.

- [Teams Development Samples](https://pnp.github.io/teams-dev-samples/): Browse community examples for building apps, bots, message extensions, and integrations for Microsoft Teams.

- [Microsoft 365 Advanced Analytics](https://github.com/pnp/Microsoft365-Analytics-Insights/wiki): Explore community guidance for Microsoft 365 advanced analytics, usage insights, and reporting.

- [Copilot Studio Samples](https://github.com/microsoft/CopilotStudioSamples): Explore official Copilot Studio samples for agent extensions, integrations, and custom experiences.

- [Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit Samples](https://github.com/OfficeDev/microsoft-365-agents-toolkit-samples): Explore official sample applications for Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit and Microsoft Teams.

- [CAT Agent Skills](https://microsoft.github.io/cat-agent-skills/): Browse reusable skills, plugins, and automations from Microsoft and the community for Copilot Studio and other Microsoft agents.





## SDKs

Find what you need to get started building your own solutions.

- [Fluent UI](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui): Build consistent, accessible web interfaces with Microsoft's Fluent UI React components, web components, and design utilities.

- [Microsoft 365 Agents SDK](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/agents-sdk/): Build and deploy agents with the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK for .NET, JavaScript, and Python.

- [Microsoft Agent Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/agent-framework/): Build agents and multi-agent workflows in .NET and Python with tools, memory, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop support.

- [Microsoft Dataverse SDK for .NET](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/org-service/overview): Work with business data and extend Microsoft Dataverse using the official .NET SDK and client libraries.

- [Microsoft Graph SDK](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/sdks/sdks-overview): Build high-quality, efficient, resilient applications that access Microsoft Graph.

- [PnP Core](https://aka.ms/pnp/coresdk/docs): A modern .NET SDK designed to work for Microsoft 365 and provide a unified object model for working with SharePoint Online, abstracting the underlying APIs.

- [PnP Framework](https://pnp.github.io/pnpframework/): A .NET library targeting Microsoft 365 containing the PnP Provisioning engine and a ton of other useful extensions.

- [PnPjs](https://pnp.github.io/pnpjs/): Call SharePoint, Graph, and Microsoft 365 REST APIs in a type-safe way with fluent libraries. For SPFx, Nodejs, or any JavaScript project.

- [Power Apps Component Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/component-framework/overview): Create reusable code components that extend model-driven and canvas apps with custom controls and richer user experiences.

- [React Reusable Controls](https://pnp.github.io/sp-dev-fx-controls-react/): Build professional-looking web parts and extensions with a set of reusable React controls that can be used in SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solutions.

- [Reusable Property Controls](https://pnp.github.io/sp-dev-fx-property-controls/): Add professional property panes to your web parts with a set of reusable property pane controls that can be used in SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solutions.





## Tools

Perform tasks with a platform-agnostic command-line interface and with PowerShell.

- [CLI for Microsoft 365](https://pnp.github.io/cli-microsoft365/): Configure Microsoft 365, manage SharePoint Framework projects and build automation scripts on Windows, macOS or Linux, using Bash, Cmder or PowerShell.

- [Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK](https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/microsoftgraph/overview): Acts as an API wrapper for the Microsoft Graph APIs for use in PowerShell. Manage identities at scale from automating tasks to managing users in bulk.

- [PnP PowerShell](https://pnp.github.io/powershell/): 700+ PowerShell cmdlets for Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Project, Security & Compliance, Microsoft Entra ID, and more.

- [Power Platform CLI](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/developer/cli/introduction): Manage environments, solutions, Dataverse, Power Pages, and code components with Microsoft's Power Platform command-line tools.

- [SP Editor](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/affnnhcbfmcbbdlcadgkdbfafigmjdkk): Browser extension for managing files (JS, CSS), modifying web/list properties, creating webhook subscriptions, editing web parts on pages, and running PnPjs TypeScript snippets.

- [Work IQ Dev Tools](https://microsoft.github.io/wiqd/getting-started/build-a-plugin/): Build, validate, and publish Microsoft 365 plugins with preview developer tools. The plugin command interface is currently alpha.





## Extensions

Boost your productivity without leaving the context of your work.

- [SharePoint Framework Toolkit](https://pnp.github.io/vscode-viva/): Develop and manage SPFx solutions without leaving VS Code. From setting up your development workspace to deploying a solution straight to your tenant.


- [CLI for Microsoft 365 extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=adamwojcikit.cli-for-microsoft-365-extension): Boost your productivity when creating scripts that use CLI for Microsoft 365. Embedded docs, samples gallery, code snippets, and more.


- [Copilot Studio VS Code Extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ms-CopilotStudio.vscode-copilotstudio): Edit and manage Copilot Studio agents in Visual Studio Code with language support, validation, and synchronization with your environments.

- [Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/platform/toolkit/overview-agents-toolkit): Create and deploy agents and apps for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams with integrated identity, Microsoft Graph, Azure, and Microsoft 365 developer tooling.


- [PnP PowerShell extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=adamwojcikit.pnp-powershell-extension): Boost your productivity when creating scripts that use PnP PowerShell. Embedded docs, samples gallery, code snippets, and more.


- [Power Platform Tools](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=microsoft-IsvExpTools.powerplatform-vscode): Create, build, and deploy Power Platform solutions and Power Pages sites in Visual Studio Code with the integrated Power Platform CLI.

- [SharePoint Embedded VS Code Extension](https://github.com/microsoft/SharePoint-Embedded-VS-Code-Extension): Develop and manage SharePoint Embedded containers and applications using the official Visual Studio Code extension.





## Forums

Get answers to questions, collaborate and communicate with the community members.

- [Copilot Studio Forum](https://community.powerplatform.com/forums/thread/?groupid=db8f53c2-767d-47d6-a1ae-fe4c828a6553): Ask questions and share solutions for Copilot Studio agents, knowledge, actions, integrations, and publishing.

- [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/YtYrav2VGW): Welcome to our vibrant Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Community Discord server, a thriving hub for enthusiasts, professionals, and learners alike.

- [Dynamics 365 Community](https://community.dynamics.com/forums/): Ask product questions, share solutions, and connect with peers across Dynamics 365 business applications.

- [Microsoft Copilot Community](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/category/microsoft-copilot): Join conversations about Microsoft Copilot and agents, explore community guidance, and learn from product experts.

- [Microsoft Graph Support](https://developer.microsoft.com/graph/support): Find official Microsoft Graph support routes for developer questions, feature requests, and known issues.

- [Microsoft Teams Development](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/tags/339/office-teams-development-routing): Ask and answer technical questions about Microsoft Teams app development, integrations, and developer APIs.

- [Microsoft Tech Community](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/): Find product communities, technical discussions, blogs, and events across Microsoft 365, Copilot, SharePoint, and other Microsoft technologies.

- [Power Apps Forum](https://community.powerplatform.com/forums/thread/?groupid=b5652dc6-2c99-4e33-8b6f-45be4a896a40): Connect with makers and developers to discuss canvas apps, model-driven apps, Dataverse, connectors, and application design.

- [Power Automate Forum](https://community.powerplatform.com/forums/thread/?groupid=46ce02a3-e1a7-4176-81fc-d93a4001d287): Find community help for cloud flows, desktop automation, connectors, process automation, and troubleshooting.

- [Power BI Community](https://community.fabric.microsoft.com/category/powerbi): Find community answers for Power BI reports, data modeling, DAX, the service, and developer integrations.

- [Power Pages Forum](https://community.powerplatform.com/forums/thread/?groupid=5499ddd0-dd7f-4c63-97e9-b2bba866b08f): Discuss building, extending, securing, and managing Power Pages sites with the maker and developer community.

- [Power Platform Community](https://community.powerplatform.com/): Join lively discussions, events, and user groups through a platform-wide community of ideas, insights, and helpful resources.

- [SharePoint Framework Issues List](https://github.com/SharePoint/sp-dev-docs/issues): Join lively discussions, events, and user groups through a platform-wide community of ideas, insights, and helpful resources.
